scope: All five printed coexistence enclosures are proved for the actual defined crossing, critical penalty, scalar infimum value, small target and large target. A tighter rational crossing bracket is certified by genuine penalized-gap signs. Stationary constant roots are enclosed by signs of their actual strictly increasing equation. Branch multiplier, cost and triangle-density formulas are evaluated by kernel-checked rational interval arithmetic and logarithm/exponential Taylor bounds over the entire crossing bracket. The original printed endpoint signs also follow. No external or internal certificate hypotheses are used.
